acceptance_criteria.criterion: KeywordGlossaryGenerator uses ModuleInfoParser::parseFile() for all YAML parsing — no direct Yaml::parseFile() calls remain
Unused imports (Yaml, ParseException, BuildMessages) are removed from KeywordGlossaryGenerator
composer test-filter -- KeywordGlossary passes in the framework
composer test-filter -- KeywordGlossary passes in the HCP Editor

summary: Replaced inline Yaml::parseFile() + manual moduleMetaData extraction in KeywordGlossaryGenerator::generate() with ModuleInfoParser::parseFile() and ModuleInfo::getId()/getKeywords() calls.
Removed three now-unused imports from KeywordGlossaryGenerator: BuildMessages, ParseException, and Yaml.
Updated writeModuleContextYaml() fixture builder in both the framework and HCP Editor test files to include required 'label' and 'description' fields, which ModuleInfoParser now validates.
composer test-filter -- KeywordGlossary passes in both the framework (34 tests, 58 assertions) and HCP Editor (11 tests, 47 assertions).

comments.note: KeywordGlossaryGenerator::generate() PHPDoc still says it 'extracts moduleMetaData.id and moduleMetaData.keywords from each' via raw array access. Now that the method delegates to ModuleInfoParser, this description is stale and should be updated to reference ModuleInfoParser.

ModuleInfoParser::parseFile() requires 'id', 'label', and 'description' to be present before returning a ModuleInfo. KeywordGlossaryGenerator only needs 'id' and 'keywords'. Any module-context.yaml that has 'id' and 'keywords' but no 'label'/'description' will now be silently skipped during glossary generation (with a BuildMessages warning). This is consistent with the parser contract but is a behaviour change worth noting: the old generator would have extracted keywords from such a file.

summary: All four acceptance criteria verified. No direct Yaml::parseFile() calls or unused imports (Yaml, ParseException, BuildMessages) remain in KeywordGlossaryGenerator — confirmed by grep. Framework suite: 34 tests, 58 assertions PASS. HCP Editor suite: 11 tests, 47 assertions PASS. Fixture builder in both test files correctly emits 'label' and 'description' fields as required by ModuleInfoParser. Null-guard for parseFile() return is in place; empty-keyword modules no-op correctly; keyword-conflict path emits onProgress warning as before.

comments.note: Class-level PHPDoc on KeywordGlossaryGenerator still says 'extracts moduleMetaData.id and moduleMetaData.keywords from each' via raw array access. Now that delegation to ModuleInfoParser is in place, this description is stale. The Developer already flagged this — Reviewer should ensure it is updated.

Behaviour change noted: modules whose module-context.yaml has 'id' and 'keywords' but lacks 'label' or 'description' are now silently skipped by the generator (ModuleInfoParser returns null, BuildMessages warning emitted). This is consistent with the parser contract but changes prior behaviour. Worth documenting in constraints.md or a WHATSNEW entry for maintainers.

summary: Code review passed. One Fix-Forward applied (stale class-level PHPDoc on KeywordGlossaryGenerator). One Documentation-Forward tagged for the silent-skip behaviour change. All four acceptance criteria confirmed met by reviewing the implementation and QA pipeline artifacts.

comments.note: Fixed stale class-level PHPDoc on KeywordGlossaryGenerator: replaced 'extracts moduleMetaData.id and moduleMetaData.keywords from each' with accurate description of ModuleInfoParser delegation and explicit note that files missing id/label/description are skipped. [documentation-forward] Behaviour change introduced in this WP: module-context.yaml files that previously had 'id' and 'keywords' but lacked 'label' or 'description' would have their keywords included in the glossary. They are now silently skipped (BuildMessages warning emitted) because ModuleInfoParser requires all three fields. Document this skip condition in constraints.md so maintainers know to include label/description in every module-context.yaml.

summary: Added a new 'Module Context YAML (module-context.yaml)' section to constraints.md documenting the three required fields (id, label, description), the silent-skip behaviour of ModuleInfoParser::parseFile() when any required field is missing, the downstream impact on glossary and overview generation, and the optional fields (keywords, relatedModules).

comments.note: [documentation-forward addressed] Added constraints.md section covering ModuleInfoParser's required-fields contract and the silent-skip behaviour. Modules whose module-context.yaml has id and keywords but lacks label or description will be skipped during glossary/overview generation — this was the behaviour change introduced in this WP and was previously undocumented.
